info.name: Online Marketplace (E-commerce) API — Spark to Code 2026
info.description:
Full Postman collection for the Online Marketplace capstone project. 12 model controllers x 8+ cases each, plus JWT register/login.

Setup:
1. Run the backend (dotnet run) — default http://localhost:5190.
2. Run 'Auth > Login' once — it auto-saves {{token}}/{{userId}}/{{role}} as collection variables.
3. Update the id variables (productId, categoryId, cartId, orderId, ...) in the collection's Variables tab to match real records (e.g. from the seed data), or capture them from each 'Create ...' response as you go.

All requests inherit Bearer auth from the collection ({{token}}); Register/Login and the public catalog-browsing GETs (Product/Category/Review list & filter endpoints) override it with No Auth.
